content.text: Dear students, are you planning to build a career in emergency medicine and surgery medical care? sections.heading: Contents
What is BSc Anesthesia and Operation Theatre Technology?

content.text: BSc Anesthesia and Operation Theatre Technology is an undergraduate program that trains students in assisting anesthesiologists, managing surgical setups, and handling the pre and post operative procedures. In this course, students will get theoretical knowledge with hospital based internships.

items: Course duration: 3 years + 6 months internship
Eligibility: 10+2 with minimum 50% in physics, chemistry, Biology
Affiliation: Most of the Bangalore colleges are affiliated with Rajiv Gandhi University of Health sciences (RGUHS)

sections.heading: Fee Structure for BSc OT and Anesthesia Technology in Bangalore

content.text: Fees for BSc Anesthesia and OT Technology colleges in Bangalore is varying based on the type of the institutions. The fees in private colleges ranges between 70K – 2L per year. Colleges with attached hospitals and advanced lab, training facilities may range from 1.5L to 2.5L per year. In government colleges or RGUHS quota fees are very lesser than management quota fees which ranges from 30K – 50K per year. Other than college fees students have to pay clinical lab usage fees, internship related expenses, semester exam fees and hostel fees (if applicable).

items: Eligibility criteria : 10+2 / PUC with minimum 50% in Physics, Chemistry, and Biology

sections.heading: Career Opportunities After BSc Anesthesia and OT Technology

content.text: After completing BSc Anesthesia and OT Technology with internship, graduates have a wide range of career opportunities in both private and government healthcare settings. Graduates will work in operation theatres, intensive care units, emergency departments, surgical wards and even in trauma care units. Some of the common job roles are OT Technologist, Anesthesia Technician, ICU care technician, surgical assistant, clinical operation executive. Freshers can expect a salary range of 18K to 30K per month based on the role and hospital.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
Can I get direct admission in BSc Anesthesia or OT in Bangalore?

content.text: Yes. Most private and hospital-based colleges offer direct admission based on 12th marks.

sections.heading: What is the average course fee for BSc Anesthesia & OT Technology in Bangalore?

content.text: It ranges from ₹70,000 to ₹2.5 lakh per year, depending on the institution.

sections.heading: Are the colleges in Bangalore affiliated to RGUHS?

content.text: Yes. Most reputed institutions in Bangalore are affiliated to Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences (RGUHS).

sections.heading: Do colleges provide internships as part of the course?

content.text: Yes. Internship is a mandatory component, usually lasting six months to one year.

sections.heading: Which colleges offer the best clinical training for this course?

content.text: Vydehi, Narayana, Sapthagiri, and Bangalore Baptist Hospital offer excellent hands-on training.

sections.heading: Is NEET required to join BSc Anesthesia or OT Technology?

content.text: No. NEET is not required for Allied Health Sciences courses.

sections.heading: What is the job scope after completing this course?

content.text: Graduates can work in operating theatres, ICUs, emergency departments, or pursue higher studies.

sections.heading: Are students from outside Karnataka eligible?

content.text: Yes. Private colleges accept students from all over India.

sections.heading: What is the difference between BSc OT and BSc Anesthesia?

content.text: Anesthesia trains students to assist in administering and monitoring anesthesia during surgeries.

sections.heading: Are placements provided after the course?

content.text: Many colleges offer placement support and hospital tie-ups for students after completion.
